gloss: to repel; to drive back; to repulse

definitions.gloss: to repel; to drive back; to repulse; to fend off
definitions.explanation: To force an enemy, attacker, or unwanted presence to retreat. Used both in military/combat contexts and figuratively for defeating opponents, pests, or challenges.

examples.japanese: {敵|てき}を{撃退|げきたい}する。
{侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}を{見事|みごと}に{撃退|げきたい}した。
examples.english: They splendidly drove back the intruder.

examples.japanese: {害虫|がいちゅう}を{撃退|げきたい}するために、{新|あたら}しい{方法|ほうほう}が{開発|かいはつ}された。
examples.english: A new method was developed to repel pests.

notes:
Composed of {撃|げき} (strike/attack) + {退|たい} (retreat), meaning to strike something so that it retreats. Used in military, sports, and everyday contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敵|てき}を{撃退|げきたい}する: to repel the enemy
- {害虫|がいちゅう}を{撃退|げきたい}する: to repel pests
- {侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}を{撃退|げきたい}する: to drive back an intruder
- {風邪|かぜ}を{撃退|げきたい}する: to fight off a cold (figurative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追|お}い{払|はら}う: to chase away — more colloquial
- {退治|たいじ}する: to exterminate/slay — implies defeating completely
- {撃破|げきは}する: to crush/destroy — stronger, implies total defeat
